_why: v23 pre-1965 backward extension. The 1965-1979 window extract already proves the method on three focus years: every ORIG/AP action carries a source line, an application type where the unfiltered Applications map has one, an official document index and a class/priority census. The same official surface for 1938-1964 turns the 1939-1964 openFDA payload block (566 ORIG/AP records, already committed) into a submission-level, line-numbered register, so a pre-1965 decision row can be checked against the same primary source instead of only the payload. Values verbatim; the only transformation is the recorded row whitelist (status date year in 1938-1964) plus the ApplNo join, exactly as the 1965-1979 job does. Applications_all_types.txt is intentionally NOT re-fetched here: data/raw/drugsatfda_data_files_2026_09/Applications_all_types.txt (29,336 rows, SHA-manifested) is the unfiltered map and is reused as the type source.
